title: Building a Visual Reference Set
description: I am adding a collection script for a visual reference dataset. The aim is to give future image work a defined body of material for comparison and testing, rather than rely on an accidental mixture of files.
body:
2026-02-21. I am adding a collection script for a visual reference dataset. The aim is to give future image work a defined body of material for comparison and testing, rather than rely on an accidental mixture of files.

What this establishes

This is a dated implementation record. It establishes an evidence-backed next step without presenting the work as complete.

Historical basis: This entry is dated to the 2026-02-21 repository milestone, commit 630d973.
